bounded-resource-search@1 (handler long.bounded-resource-search, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisites and dependencies navigate, probe and gather, references {} since no parameter names a target, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event) is a multi-round work record under bounded-resource-search:work:open that takes exactly one dependency step per round through the dependency's own code and nothing else: the kernel navigate step (v7NavigateStep, the unchanged kernel.navigate function of foundation-forest@1, now also exported, with no behavior change), the observe mode of OPEN_FOUNDATION.handlers['open.probe'] (1 round, 0.2 energy, never a material trial) or FOREST_BASE.handlers['forest.gather'] (1 round, 2 energy per unit, real stock and reach revalidated at transfer, exactly n units moved to an owned item). A person moves only inside that kernel step and at most once per round, so the step stays speed x dt / travel factor <= 0.8 along the observed route with the actual-obstacle check, the carried-mass effort and the swept-body checks of v7Step; each navigate step is first priced by running the same kernel step on a copy of the person, is not taken if it would pass the path, energy or reserve limit, must match that priced copy exactly, and a guard refuses any step above 0.8 (a 60-round test with everyone else rushing confirms no round moves anyone more than 0.8 and that the search moves only through one kernel moved or arrived event). Candidates come only from v7Observe (vision 5) and the person's own memory of sources out of view: objects with data.resource equal to the named resource whose centre is within the radius of the origin (default the person's position), with stock of at least one unit, not created by another person and not blocked in this run, nearest straight-line gap to interaction reach first; sources currently seen with zero stock are recorded as seen facts and not visited; only when no stocked source is known may it walk to an observed, dry, obstacle-free cell inside the radius from which unseen cells of the area lie within vision, never to unseen ground; a known stocked source that cannot fit the lower bounds of reach, inspection and one unit stops the search with the binding limit instead of walking on. It completes at the quantity or when no stocked source and no unseen ground remain (an honest result with zero units is possible), and stops before any step at the path limit, the time limit (every world round since the start, paused ones included), the energy budget, the energy reserve or an unsafe state (health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 or more from 22, or an injury in the last round, the kernel's own urgent-risk lines). Another action, a refused round or a simultaneous conflict pauses it after the environment, resume rechecks everything and inspects again before any harvest, cancel ends it in one round at no cost, death ends it through onDeath and carried units follow the ordinary death rules once; one open search per person; nothing is held in escrow, refunded, created or eaten. Modeling assumptions: the probe's observed stock counts exposed ripe units; one gather takes min(stock, quantity left, units the budget and reserve allow) in its own single round, as a person could; there is no carrying limit beyond navigate's carried-mass cost; plants carry no owner, so only sources created by another person are treated as theirs; the travel-cost order and the feasibility test use the straight-line gap, 0.8 per round and 2 energy per distance as lower bounds of navigate's route and travel factor; a navigate failure such as goal-overlap leaves that target out for the run and uses the round; the parameter maxima are radius 8, path 16, time 40, energy 40 and quantity 20. No reward: every event carries this interface, so no satisfaction rule matches, practiceEvidence is the completed event without a qualified flag, and open-experience.ts gates routine and progress accounting by this revision so that a search round counts exactly as the same navigate, probe or gather step by hand (tested against a manual run and an idle run). The ability serializes to 2819 code units (limit 3500), every earlier package is byte-identical by its id@version digest, and the ex25 heat-exposure test now asserts that it is the last long-ex25 package rather than the last package overall.

reciprocal-conversation@1 (handler long.reciprocal-conversation, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisite and dependency tell, references {} since no parameter names a target, execution duration 1, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event, no satisfaction rule) is a two-person conversation session built on tell: every spoken step (propose, join, resume, contribute) calls tell's own handler (expression.tell of foundation-expression@1, taken from expressionFoundation for the installed scope), so its told event is delivered by tell's own after-round delivery to exactly tell's hearers (every other living person within config.vision = 5 at the end of the round, seen or not) with tell's heard events and bounded heard lists (tested against a plain tell at 4.99 and 5.01); a contribution is exactly the person's words (at most 240 characters), while propose, join and resume say a short line naming the session id and topic plus optional words, within 240. Each spoken mode costs what tell costs (1 round, 0 energy, 0 material, tested against the same tells by hand); pause, leave and cancel say nothing and cost no energy, but like every action they occupy the person's action for that round, because the kernel runs exactly one action per person per round. Range: propose needs the invited person alive, seen now (v7Observe) and within 5, and join, resume, contribute and pause need the other participant alive and within 5 at the start of the round, checked before anything about the session is revealed; a person out of range gets the same answer as for an unknown id or person. The session record is hidden world state (reciprocal-conversation:sessions) written only after the round's actions, so simultaneous steps of both people never conflict; each person's own record (reciprocal-conversation:work:open, shown with active work, and reciprocal-conversation:last) holds only their own acts, the other's acceptances and words they actually heard and changes that happened within 5 of them: an invited person learns of a session only by hearing its invitation or the proposer's join; a leave, cancel or death of the other person more than 5 away is disclosed only when they are within 5 again or at the expiry round, and until then the record stays as it would have been (an active one pauses for range); the other person's pause reasons show only within 5; every notice is a positionless event seen only by its own person. Lifecycle: proposing is not consent; the session becomes active at the end of a round in which both have joined with the exact topic, each heard the other's join, both are alive within 5 and neither is at an urgent risk; while active, a round that is not a step of that session, wait (silence) or a refused step of this interface pauses it, as do being more than 5 apart and an urgent risk (the kernel's lines also used by bounded-resource-search@1: health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 or more from 22, or an injury in the last round); resume needs both people again, each heard by the other; leave or cancel by either participant, death (onDeath) or the expiry round (proposal round plus rounds, 1 to 20, not extended by pausing) ends it, and words already said stay heard. A contribution is committed only when the other participant actually heard it (their heard event is the delivery evidence); otherwise it is reported as interrupted and does not count. A reciprocal exchange is recorded once per utterance pair, with both event ids, speakers, listeners, topic, rounds and heard evidence, when a committed contribution names in respondsTo an earlier committed utterance of the other person (which the responder heard) and uses new words, so acceptances, proposals, identical retries and simultaneous unrelated utterances never form one, and each first utterance completes at most one exchange. Modeling assumptions: the topic is fixed per session and must be named exactly in join, so a new topic needs a new session that both join independently; resume is spoken (a short tell) so that reaffirmation is audible like join; the session id is assigned as session-<round>-<proposer>; a person may have one open session they proposed and any number they were invited to; wait is the silent turn and any other action counts as another action; invite is not called (people may still use it themselves) and message delivery is not used as evidence; there are no group sessions or new media; the hidden record of a closed session is kept 40 rounds after its end once nobody's own record of it is open, while its events stay in the event journal. No reward: no satisfaction rule, no event carries a qualified flag or numeric progress, practiceEvidence is the exchange notice without a qualified flag, and vitals, wellbeing, mood, pleasure, routine and progress accounting equal those of the same words by tell (tested); nothing is created, moved, granted or charged beyond tell. The ability serializes to 2235 code units (limit 3500), every earlier package is byte-identical by its id@version digest, and the bounded-resource-search test now asserts that it is the first long-ex26 package rather than the last package overall.

tend-rooted-plants@1 (handler long.tend-rooted-plants, scope long-ex26, learning 3 with no study energy, prerequisite and dependency probe, references { target: object } so that the shared resolver accepts only one object the person sees now through v7Observe, execution duration 1, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event, no satisfaction rule) tends an established rooted food plant within reach: a plant of a food resource with growth properties that the existing plant rule grows (growth interval above 0), not fish or a fungus (mushroom, red-fungus) and not a seedling. Every refusal costs nothing (no target, target not in view or only remembered, out of reach, an item, not eligible); reach is checked before eligibility and every ineligible target gets the same words, so a refusal reveals only ineligibility, and a remembered plant out of view is refused exactly like an unknown id. inspect calls probe's own handler (open.probe of foundation-open@1, observe mode: 1 round, 0.2 energy, its observed-state record) and adds the plant's growth contract read from the inputs of the existing evaluator (forestGrowth as openPlants calls it, with openConditions, forestClimate and longPressure): growth per ripe unit (the interval), growth so far, stock and capacity, the least rounds to the next unit at the evaluator's ceiling growthScale x maximum daylight 0.65 + 11/30 (a test confirms that no plant ever grows faster), the temperature range (no growth at minGrowth, full at optimalGrowth), the moisture need, waterlogging, harvest pressure 1/(1 + depletion/20), the period pressure and what limits growth now. The first inspection records a baseline in a persistent patch record (patch id, plant, the one square unit around it, status, baseline and latest probe values with evidence ids, counts, the last assessment, and treatment, work, inputs, soil change and last maintenance, which stay empty); later inspections report the observed change since the baseline; at most 8 records are kept and a dropped one is named. The plant model represents temperature, daylight, season, soil moisture from the ground type with drought and waterlogging hazards, harvest depletion, the growth scale, period pressure, interval and capacity, seedling establishment, and dispersal with a 0.6 m placement clearance; it represents no surface crust, compaction, nutrient or competing vegetation, and no plant's growth depends on any other object (tested). So no hand loosening or clearing can change any plant: prepare and maintain report 'no corrective work indicated' in one round at 0 energy and change nothing. The specified costs of actual work (prepare 3 rounds at 2 energy, maintain 1 round at 1 energy) are published but cannot be charged, no working depth applies because no loosening is executable, no crust, compaction or competition state was invented and no multiplier exists, so every plant regrows only under the existing rule; a 120-round run in which Wren inspects, prepares and maintains two plants is byte-identical in every object to the same run without the package. Watering is not needed: for Wren's berry and root plants ordinary soil gives moisture 0.65 against needs of 0.6 and 0.5, so the moisture factor is already 1, and no water transfer was added; where a plant needs more (a fern root at 0.65 against 0.7, or a plant on rocky ground) inspection says that water would help but that this operation carries none. Reuse: probe is called for every inspection; v7Observe bounds every target through the kernel's reference resolver; forestGrowth, openConditions, forestClimate and longPressure are read, and openPlants, unchanged, remains the only growth; navigate and gather are not called: nobody is moved, travel stays with navigate and harvest with gather at its own cost, and nothing is created, refunded or eaten. There is no labor, so nothing is left pending or paused: another action pauses nothing, a repeated call rechecks reach and eligibility, cancel closes one record (target in view) or all records (no target) without undoing or refunding anything, and death closes the open records and leaves plants, soil and items as they are. No reward: no satisfaction rule, practiceEvidence is the inspected event without a qualified flag, and open-experience.ts, gated by this revision, counts every round of it as a probe round (routine unless meaningful, never progress work), so routine, vitals, wellbeing and experience equal those of the same probe by hand (tested). Modeling assumptions: fungi and fish are not rooted plants; harvest and period pressure are limits that hand work cannot change; the best-rate bound uses no depletion, full daylight and every other factor at 1; quantity counts rounds of indicated work and stays unused; patch records are personal and reach ordinary input only through the events.
